gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Galaxy draws every letter with one unbroken line width, packed into a tall lowercase band and spaced loosely across the line. Noto Sans Elbasan, a plain sans, keeps its large forms open beneath it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open and its ascenders just above the x-height, so text feels tidy and modern. And Galaxy does the loud work, with constant-width lines and a cosmic, commanding stance.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Galaxy leads with a cosmic, commanding wire-like line. Noto Sans Ethiopic follows in a plain sans with sturdy, tall lowercase and hanging c terminals, so the loose display spacing hands over to a firmer, more grounded text texture.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Open curves and short ascender stems make Noto Sans Georgian read clean and modern, with little to snag the eye. And Galaxy, with its full-width stroke connections and loose spacing, stands apart as the louder partner above it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads as a plain sans with open round letters and a tall, sturdy lowercase that stay clear at small sizes. Galaxy above it keeps even its diagonals as heavy as its stems.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads, with round forms like open parentheses. But Galaxy, cosmic and loosely spaced in a single line weight, feels like a sharper, tighter neighbor beside them.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha reads as a sans of tall little letters, like pen-nib bowls pressed flat, with no closed-up bowl to catch on. And over a long stretch it stays smooth, never snagging while Galaxy sits above as the plotter-pen headline.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Gujarati ends its curves before they turn inward. Over a long passage it stays open and easygoing, its large counters giving a plain sans texture that Galaxy's wire-bent letters never compete with.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Galaxy bends every letter like a single wire, with no swelling where curves meet stems, and sets them loosely in a tall lowercase band. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi, a plain sans with cut-back terminals, feels softer beside it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Galaxy's line carries no pressure swell where a curve turns a corner, and its cosmic, commanding letters are spaced loosely. Noto Sans Gurmukhi, a sans with outward-pointing terminals, reads steadily over a long stretch.
